---
title: MANE
description: MANE's matched RefSeq and Ensembl transcript per human gene, and its rows in annotation.identifier_mapping.
---

[MANE](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/refseq/MANE/) (Matched Annotation from
NCBI and EMBL-EBI) names, per human protein-coding gene, one transcript that
RefSeq and Ensembl annotate identically (MANE Select), plus MANE Plus Clinical
transcripts where Select alone cannot report every known pathogenic variant.
The release lands the summary file whole and derives
`annotation.mane__transcript`, one row per matched pair. The release number
in the file name is the version.

## Licence and citation

[NCBI Molecular Data Usage](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/)
terms. Cite the MANE release and [Morales et al. 2022](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/refseq/MANE/).

## Join keys

- RefSeq accessions keep their version (`NM_000546.6`), as the `REFSEQ_RNA` and `REFSEQ_PROTEIN` namespaces of `annotation.identifier_mapping` do.
- Ensembl ids are split into stable id and version, so `ensembl_transcript_id` joins `annotation.transcript.transcript_id` and `ensembl_gene_id` joins `annotation.gene.gene_id` directly.
- `annotation.identifier_mapping` rows under `source = 'MANE'` pair RefSeq and Ensembl transcripts (namespace `ENSEMBL_TRANSCRIPT`), for taxon 9606.

## Good to know

- The 70 `NR_` rows have no protein; `HGNC_ID` is missing on a few dozen rows.
- Only the summary is landed; the release's GFF, GTF and FASTA are not.
